slice: connected application-link availability facet in Jobs saved searches

environment.database: temporary SQLite; PostgreSQL dialect compilation only

implemented: Jobs provides an accessible Application link facet with All, Available, and Unavailable choices.

Available includes only exact persisted application_url_status PROVIDER_SUPPLIED; Unavailable includes only exact UNAVAILABLE. Missing, inferred, unknown, and malformed values fail closed when a facet is selected.
The database predicate composes with other filters before LIMIT; saved-search validation and persistence accept the optional supported enum while retaining legacy payload compatibility.
The connected UI sends the filter, saves and restores it per profile, and lets an explicit empty request override a saved value without changing the saved value.
Connected Chromium verified available/unavailable/unknown/missing results, saved-search reload and restore, UUID-based search identity, and clearing a saved AVAILABLE filter back to all statuses.
Filtering causes no discovery scheduling, application creation, external requests, or submission side effects.
behavior.remaining: Other MJ-REQ-189 facets and connected product requirements remain incomplete. PostgreSQL runtime and live job-source behavior remain unverified; this slice does not complete issue #190 or MJ-REQ-189.
